publisher_name: Büro Milk (Milk Studio, s. r. o.)
independence_evidence: Site footer: 'Published by Büro Milk'; privacy policy names the operator as Milk Studio, s. r. o., Bilíkova 30, Bratislava, a small design studio; no media group.
qualifies_reason: Independent Bratislava design-interview magazine whose Issue #9 ('Ready or not') was released in 2026 (listed 28 August 2026).
what_it_is: Backstage Talks is an English-language magazine of long conversations with designers, studio founders and creative directors about the business side of design: pricing, growth, sustainability of practice and how decisions get made. Issue #9, themed around complexity and change, interviews figures such as Bráulio Amado, Liza Enebeis of Studio Dumbar and Tosin Oshinowo and adds a short guide and a crash course in complexity science. It suits working designers, studio owners and design students.
